frozenTask.completion: The shot exists, is the active typed shot, its camera is the selected active object, and the scene camera points to it

officialBaseline.semanticProxy: Four generic scene objects named PROJECT_PRJ_REMAINDER, SCENE_SC01, CHARACTER_CHR_GUARDIAN and SHOT_SH010_WIDE; the shot proxy is a Camera and is selected
officialBaseline.route: For each proxy use Search, enter the add command, confirm, Rename, enter the frozen name, confirm

f0Target.taskRoute: One visible Create Shot action on the native Film Mode start surface
f0Target.strictInteractionAdvantage: actual F0 task interactions must be less than actual official baseline interactions

interactionCounting.counted: Every deliberate click, key chord, text entry, or confirmation sent to the application is one interaction
interactionCounting.errors: Any unintended operator, correction, undo, or failed UI action increments errorCount
interactionCounting.timing: Monotonic wall time begins at the first counted input and ends when the frozen completion state is visibly reached

implementationContract.stateStorage: Versioned RNA PropertyGroup state attached to Scene and serialized in .blend
implementationContract.filmMode: Topbar start surface directly exposes frozen Project, Scene, Character and active Shot plus Create Shot and Expert Mode actions
implementationContract.expertMode: Restores the complete Blender menus and workspace tabs without copying or converting scene state
implementationContract.shotCreation: Creates a real Camera and cross-binds it to the typed shot, active object and scene camera

negativeControls: Open a valid .blend after removing optional Film Studio shot entries; core Project, Scene and Character state must load and the UI must offer Create Shot without error
Switch Film Mode to Expert Mode and back; canonical typed state and camera identity must remain exact
persistence: Save, quit, reopen and independently audit the exact typed identifiers, selected shot and camera binding
stopRules: Do not mutate source before this preregistration is committed and pushed
Do not launch a native Blender process below 160 GiB free
Do not count Python console or audit scripts as user interaction
Do not pass if state is only labels, custom layout or hidden menus without typed persistent state
Do not weaken the one-interaction F0 target or the strict less-than baseline rule after observing results
